title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Opening Featuring "Drawing days" by SPLAY
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first opening, featuring SPLAY’s “Drawing days,” as part of the series’ ongoing 20th anniversary celebrations. The opening was used for Episodes 1-26 of the TV anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: A Mysterious Figure Appears in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 11 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 11 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 6 premiere. The episode previously revealed its title to be “Turning Point 4,” with fans already ready for it to be another major moment in Rudy’s life.
author: Anime Corner

title: From Far Away TV Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime of Kyouko Hikawa 's From Far Away ( Kanata Kara ) shōjo manga presented the anime's main promotional video, key visual, and additional cast and staff members on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "Tōkōkō" by boy group Genin wa Jibun ni Aru.
author: ANN

title: Saint Seiya Creator Masami Kurumada Sues Former Manager, Others for 2.8 Billion Yen
content: Manga creator Masami Kurumada ( Saint Seiya , B'tX , Ring ni Kakero ) announced in a press conference in Tokyo on Wednesday that he has filed a lawsuit against a former board director and others from three of his companies for allegedly misappropriating funds without authorization.
author: ANN

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard Anime Director Yuji Yanase Dies at 59
content: Anime director Yuji Yanase, who directed the currently airing The World’s Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country’s Novice Seeker , died on August 22, 2026. He was 59 years old. title: Main Staff for 'Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai' Announced
content: Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced the main staff for the anime adaptation of Murakawa 's Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai ( Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land ) manga on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Director, Animator Yūji Yanase Dies
content: Director and animator Yūji Yanase died on August 22. The official website for The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne anime made the announcement on Wednesday. Yanase directed the anime, which premiered on July 6.
author: ANN

title: Yuuji Yanase, Director of 'Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.', Dies at 59
content: Yuuji Yanase , the director behind Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni. ( In Another World With My Smartphone ), died on August 22 due to myocardial infarction. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Drawbacks That Stop Naruto From Becoming The Greatest Anime of All Time
content: The legacy of the Shonen Big Three remains unmatched even though several years have passed since their debut. As the new era of the anime and manga industry began with shorter and seasonal series, fans appreciate the older generation even more with long-running stories and captivating plots.
author: ComicBook

title: Building the Dark Fantasy "Sentenced to Be a Hero" with Studio KAI
content: Studio KAI was founded in 2019, and their name "KAI" means "oar" in Japanese. Since an oar is a tool used when rowing a boat, Studio KAI's mission is to row boldly into the endless ocean of animation with passion and determination.
author: MyAnimeList
